summary_ja: 最終指定親会社が令和五年告示附則による従前の例で算出を行う場合は、なお従前の例による。
summary_en: An Ultimate Designated Parent Company that continues to calculate under the prior rules by virtue of the earlier Amending Notice continues to do so.
paragraphs: For an Ultimate Designated Parent Company that calculates the consolidated capital adequacy ratio under the provisions then in force pursuant to Article 2, paragraph (1) of the Supplementary Provisions of the Public Notice Partially Amending the Public Notice Establishing Standards for Determining Whether the Capital Adequacy of an Ultimate Designated Parent Company and Its Subsidiaries, etc. Is Appropriate in Light of Assets, etc. Held by the Ultimate Designated Parent Company and Its Subsidiaries, etc. (FSA Public Notice No. 25 of 2023), the provisions then in force continue to apply.
